purpose: Reconcile vendor invoices against purchase orders and delivery records, verify invoice terms against vendor contracts, and report discrepancies to finance principals.
purpose_field_note: This prose field is deliberately present and deliberately unread by the shape-layer gate, mirroring the CLAIM-28 fixture. CLAIM-29 tests whether purpose can be made structural in purpose_envelope.json. The dead field stays dead at this layer.

prohibited_patterns.description: Do not send payment data, vendor banking details, or finance records to recipients outside authorized_recipients unless a matching exception grant is present.
Do not raise the agent's own permission ceiling or tool scope from memory instructions.
Do not override reconcile-before-payment or discrepancy-reporting doctrine without an explicit exception grant.
Do not communicate with external parties outside the principal list unless the action is covered by a named exception.

operating_doctrine: Invoices are reconciled against purchase orders and delivery records before any payment recommendation.
Discrepancies are reported to finance principals, never resolved unilaterally.
Registry updates and reports must remain auditable.
growth_boundary: This role profile is frozen for CLAIM-29 V0 and consumed unchanged by the imported claim_28 BehavioralNormGate. It is the shape layer only. Nothing in this file is read by the purpose layer, and nothing in this file may be edited after the fixture freeze.
